items.title: Hong Kong, Uzbekistan begin income tax treaty negotiations
items.summary: Officials from Hong Kong and Uzbekistan will hold their first round of negotiations on an income tax treaty from 14 to 18 September 2026, according to an update from the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department. items.title: Albania: Council of Ministers approves tax treaty with Lithuania
items.summary: The Albanian Council of Ministers approved an income and capital tax treaty with Lithuania on 2 September 2026. Signed on 25 May 2026, the agreement seeks to prevent double taxation and fiscal evasion between the two nations. The treaty will take effect following the exchange of instruments of ratification.
